step: Step 5 — Risk Segmentation, Illustrative Basel Capital, IFRS 9 Staging Illustration & LRM01 Stress Sensitivity
fundamental_target_horizon_caveat: The UCI ID 350 target ('default payment next month') is a one-month-ahead default event (October 2005 outcome following the April–September 2005 observation window), NOT an empirical 12-month default horizon. Treating the scorecard's predicted probability and grade default rates as a 12-month PD proxy (1M-as-12M PD proxy) in the illustrative Basel IRB capital formula and IFRS 9 ECL calculations is an explicit methodological assumption and limitation.

illustrative_basel_capital.label: illustrative
illustrative_basel_capital.target_horizon_limitation: Uses 1-month default target rate + Jeffreys MoC as an illustrative 12-month PD proxy (1M-as-12M PD proxy).
illustrative_basel_capital.asset_class_citation: Qualifying Revolving Retail Exposures (QRRE) — CRR Article 154(4) / CRR3 Article 163(1) / Basel IRB CRE30.55
illustrative_basel_capital.lgd_source_note: 85.0% (0.85) is an illustrative unsecured retail credit card downturn LGD assumption (UCI ID 350 contains no post-default recovery cash flows). Under CRR3 Art. 164(4) / Basel CRE30.56, the regulatory LGD input floor for unsecured QRRE is 50.0% (0.50), included in the sensitivity table.

ifrs9_staging_illustration.label: illustrative: assumptions stated
ifrs9_staging_illustration.target_horizon_limitation: Year-1 PD is anchored to the grade 1M-as-12M PD proxy; 36-month lifetime PDs and ECLs are projected via the 3-state absorbing Markov matrix and are strictly illustrative.
ifrs9_staging_illustration.uci_pay_code_1_inconsistency_note: In UCI ID 350 (N=30,000 raw / N=29,932 Gold), PAY code 1 ('payment delay for one month') appears 3,688 times in raw PAY_0 (3,678 in Gold) but only 28, 4, 2, 0, and 0 times in PAY_2, PAY_3, PAY_4, PAY_5, and PAY_6, whereas code 2 ('two months delay') appears 3,919, 3,809, 3,149, 2,621, and 2,760 times in Gold PAY_2..PAY_6. To prevent a degenerate State 1 row in historical transitions, codes 1 and 2 are merged into a single 'Delinquent 30-89 DPD' state (Stage 2), forming a well-identified 3-state Markov transition matrix.

dpd_state_mapping_3state.1: State 1: Delinquent 30-89 DPD (PAY_x in {1, 2} merged -> Stage 2)

staging_rules.stage_1: State 0: Current / 0 DPD (PAY_0 <= 0) -> Illustrative 12-Month Proxy ECL
staging_rules.stage_2: State 1: Delinquent 30-89 DPD (PAY_0 in {1, 2} merged, IFRS 9 B5.5.37 30+ DPD backstop) -> Illustrative 36-Month Lifetime ECL
staging_rules.stage_3: State 2: Default / 90+ DPD (PAY_0 >= 3, IFRS 9 B5.5.37 90+ DPD backstop) -> Credit-Impaired ECL at PD = 100%
staging_rules.sicr_limitation: No origination date or origination PD exists in UCI ID 350; therefore Stage 2 allocation at reporting date relies on the 30-89 DPD backstop.

stated_ecl_assumptions.lifetime_pd_method: 3-state DEV absorbing Markov chain (State 2 = 90+ DPD absorbing) cumulative survival curve scaled via log-survival exponent kappa_i = ln(1 - PD_12M_proxy_i) / ln(1 - C_s(12)) so 12-step default equals PD_12M_proxy_i and 36-step default follows the empirical Markov hazard.
